cards.text: Jesus has just had a long talk at night with Nicodemus, a Pharisee and a leader of the Jews (John 3:1-21). After this, Jesus heads out into the Judean countryside with His disciples and spends some time with them there. And He baptizes.
Meanwhile John the Baptist, who's been baptizing with water beyond the Jordan (John 1:26, 28), is out baptizing at Aenon near Salim. And people KEEP coming.

cards.question: John is baptizing at Aenon near Salim because the ___ was plentiful there.
The writer slips in a side note here. At this point, John has already been thrown into prison.

cards.text: Then a dispute breaks out between John's disciples and a certain Jew.

cards.question: What's the dispute between John's disciples and a certain Jew about?

cards.text: So John's disciples go to him and call him Rabbi. They bring up the One who was with John beyond the Jordan, the One John testified about.

cards.question: John's disciples tell him Jesus is baptizing now. What do they say about the people?

answers.text: Everyone is staying away from Him

cards.text: EVERYONE. Not some. Not most. EVERYONE. Now it's John's turn to answer.

cards.question: John's disciples just told him everyone is going to Jesus. What's the first thing John says back?

answers.text: A man can receive only what is given him from heaven
A man has to protect what he has built
A man should not baptize without a teacher

cards.question: John reminds his disciples that they heard him say he is the Christ.

cards.text: Then John paints a wedding picture, and since I bake for a wedding feast, now he's speaking MY language. The bride belongs to the bridegroom, and the friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him.

cards.question: In John's wedding picture, the friend of the bridegroom is ___ to hear the bridegroom's voice.
John says the joy of the bridegroom's friend is his own joy, and it is now complete.
John sums up where he stands next to Jesus. What does he say?

answers.text: He must increase and I must decrease
We must grow side by side
I must lead and He must follow

cards.text: John keeps going. He talks about two kinds of speakers: the One who comes from above, and the one who is from the earth.

cards.question: John says the one from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks like it. What does he say about the One who comes from heaven?

cards.text: The One from heaven testifies to what He has seen and heard, FIRSTHAND. Not like me back in the junk drawer, guessing what the kitchen was up to from the rattle of the scissors.

cards.question: John says everyone accepts the testimony of the One from heaven.
John adds a line about whoever does accept the testimony of the One from heaven. What has that person certified?

answers.text: That he has kept the law
That he is ready to be baptized

cards.text: So why does accepting that testimony say God is truthful? John spells out where those words come from.

cards.question: John says someone speaks the words of God. Who is it?

answers.text: The One whom God has sent
The one who is from the earth

cards.text: And John adds that God gives the Spirit WITHOUT limit. Then he says the Father loves the Son.

cards.question: John says the Father has placed only some things in the Son's hands.

cards.text: Then John lands the whole thing with two roads: believe in the Son, or reject Him. No third lane, friend, and not even a shoulder to pull over on.

cards.question: What does whoever believes in the Son have?
John says the wrath of God remains on whoever rejects the Son.
